title.fr: Oscillations électriques libres amorties (circuit RLC série)

formula: L · d²q/dt² + R · dq/dt + q/C = 0   (équation différentielle)
sketch:
Observe: SVG schematic (R, L, C, switch charged to E) left; polyline
u_C(t) damped oscillation right. Depending on regime (pseudo-
périodique, critique, apériodique), curve shape changes. Student
sweeps R with L, C fixed; pseudo-period T ≈ 2π√(LC) HUD; critical
R = 2√(L/C) threshold marker. Experiment: 3 seeded target
envelopes; student picks R to match damping. Evaluate: curve
hidden, only target envelope + T; submit R, L, C blind. Wrinkle:
needs Euler (not exact integrator) since 2nd-order; dt clamp OK.
